answer: Sybil resistance follows from temporally decayed EigenTrust: reputation has an exponential half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to accumulate eigenvector centrality. Freshly spawned sybil identities begin near zero, and isolated collusion cannot bootstrap trust because reciprocity-weighted transitivity is bounded by established peers. Whether labeled wharf, island, or raven, such identities cannot pass consensus without durable support.
